description: On the tabletop in front of you are an open black glasses case, a yellow ball on a small blue scoop, a wooden stick, yellow plastic tongs, a blue cup, and a red Sharpie marker. The right hand moves in from the right toward the gray-handled metal tool near the bottom, grasps it as a right-hand object, lifts it up and forward, and places it into the open black case before releasing, while the left hand stays hovering near the yellow ball without touching anything.
